title: 花生有人要咗
mood: bittersweet, earnest, glad and a little lost
subject: an office worker who has walked the same nine-year-old black shelter dog, Peanut, every Saturday for two years at a dog shelter in Sheung Shui, and arrives one Saturday to find her kennel empty because a family adopted her on Wednesday, so he walks a young brown dog called Tofu instead
caption: Cantonese-language Midwest emo, late-90s twinkly emo revival style. Two clean electric guitars in open tuning playing interlocking twinkly tapped arpeggios, a melodic electric bass moving under them, busy live drums with math-rock accents and stop-start fills, and a lone trumpet playing a simple line in the bridge. Bright, roomy, basement-recorded indie mix with the guitars ringing in light reverb, unpolished. Male Cantonese lead with an earnest, unpolished tenor that strains on the high notes, friends joining in gang vocals on the last chorus. 140 BPM, D major. Bittersweet and earnest, glad and a little lost. No pop-punk power chords, no screamed vocals, no synths, no trap drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
上水嗰間狗屋 禮拜六九點
我簽個名 攞條狗帶 行去第七格
花生已經企定 條尾搖到停唔到
佢全身黑色 九歲 個嘴白咗一半

[Pre-Chorus]
兩年嚟有人嚟睇 冇人揀佢
人哋話佢老 我話佢只係行得慢

[Chorus]
花生 行慢啲 唔緊要
梧桐河邊 行到第三支燈柱先返
你逐條草咁嗅 我等你
禮拜六 我淨係得你

[Verse]
今個禮拜六 我照舊九點到
第七格張毯摺好咗 個碗洗得好乾淨
姑娘行過嚟 笑住同我講
花生禮拜三 有人要咗

[Pre-Chorus]
一家四口 個細路一眼揀中佢
話佢最乖 唔搶嘢食

[Chorus]
花生 行慢啲 唔緊要
你新屋企 有個露台曬到太陽
你逐條草咁嗅 有人等你
禮拜六 我揸住一條空狗帶

[Verse]
姑娘話 不如你行下其他嗰啲
第十二格有隻啡色 叫做豆腐
佢一見我 成個撲埋嚟
扯住我向前衝 一步都冇停過

[Bridge]
我好開心 我真係好開心
只係梧桐河邊 第三支燈柱
今日我冇停低

[Chorus]
豆腐 行慢啲 唔緊要
梧桐河邊 行到第三支燈柱先返
你逐條草咁嗅 我等你
花生 你喺新屋企 都要行慢啲

[Outro]
禮拜六九點 我會再嚟
